notes.title: February 11, 2018 Updated version 1.16.40.0211
notes.content:
update content:	
1.Adjusted the properties of the ships of the 3 major races.In particular, adjust the speed of novice ships to make it more balanced.Novice vessels in the old archive and already built vessels and accessories will not be affected by this adjustment.If the player wants a new novice ship that has been adjusted, you need to restart the game.
2. Increased the hit rate of normal shooting.
3. The target pirate's blood volume shows.
4. Reduce the airship pirate's blood.
5.Optimized attack range indicator on and off function.
6.Remove the unnecessary pirate locator display.
7.Now, the Pirates focus will be automatically shut down after leaving the target pirate a certain distance
